title: IPC/HTTP gateway: define protocol v2 bump + migration harness
summary: Protocol JSON shapes are stabilizing, but there is no explicit migration harness for the first breaking change. Define a v2 bump policy + a small compatibility test harness so future schema changes are intentional and testable.
expectedFailureModes: A breaking schema change lands without a version bump and silently breaks clients.
No replay harness exists, so compatibility claims rely on memory instead of fixtures.
Version negotiation drifts and produces ambiguous errors at runtime.
nextAction: Write a short protocol versioning/migration note and add a compatibility harness test that can replay v1 fixtures against the current parser.
